sources.title: GitHub - anmol-shrivastav/tts-hindi: Lightweight Node.js Hindi Text-to ...
sources.snippet: A lightweight Node.js Text-to-Speech application for Hindi using Piper and ONNX voice models from rhasspy/piper-voices. This project provides a simple Express server with both standard and streaming TTS endpoints, along with browser-based demo pages for testing speech generation quickly.
